cohort: Inpatients at eleven hospitals in An-Giang province, Vietnam, who received treatment with cephalosporins during the period of January to December 2015.
finding: Cefotaxime was the most frequently used cephalosporin, often in combination with gentamycin, primarily for pneumonia, gastrointestinal infections, and cesarean sections, accounting for 98% of total injectable antibiotic costs (6.61 billion VND) over the study period.
